items.text: Kickoff flexed to 1:00 p.m. ET. Philadelphia QB: Jalen Hurts on IR (blood clots, expected out for season); Nick Sirianni confirmed Joe Milton III starts (matches schedule).

Philadelphia (Wed): DNP - LB Zack Baun (back). LIMITED - WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring), WR Dontayvion Wicks (ankle), CB Jonathan Jones (hamstring), DB Michael Carter II (abdomen), OLB Nolan Smith (illness), RB Will Shipley (IR return). Full - RB Saquon Barkley, LB Jihaad Campbell.

Pittsburgh (Wed/Thu): LB Nick Herbig (hip/ribs) DNP both days; LB Patrick Queen (hand) limited. WR Michael Pittman Jr. and S DeShon Elliott upgraded to full Thu; WR Roman Wilson full. G Mason McCormick (ankle, carted off Week 10) likely out multiple weeks. Aaron Rodgers starts.
